# AAPL 2024Q3 bounded revenue growth

Assessment cutoff: 2024-08-02T23:59:59+00:00, latest over eligible local evidence, not today's market. Authored 2026-11-16T01:57:33.068714+00:00.

Quarterly revenue growth is 4.865704%, compared with Q2 -4.305327%, an improvement of 9.171031 percentage points. This answers the revenue year-over-year question, not investment merit.

Recalculation in USD millions: (85,777 / 81,797 - 1)*100; Q2: (90,753 / 94,836 - 1)*100. Both use three-month columns, not nine/six-month cumulative columns. Category changes reconcile to +3,980: Services +3,000; iPad +1,371; Mac +169; iPhone -373; Wearables/Home/Accessories -187. Services supplies 75.38% of the net increase, not 75.38% of revenue.

The improvement is uneven. iPhone and wearables declines oppose a broad demand-recovery interpretation. Greater China also declines (14,728/15,758-1 = -6.536362%). Mix, launch timing and currency can explain changes without durable unit-volume growth; no unit volumes or causal decomposition verified. Do not average category percentages or add geographic sales to product sales. Quarter-to-quarter revenue levels are seasonal, so compare year-over-year rates rather than treating Q3's lower absolute revenue as sequential deterioration.

[Q3 original](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000081/aapl-20240629.htm), MD&A pp14-15, category table and accompanying drivers; [Q2 original](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000069/aapl-20240330.htm), MD&A pp14-15, comparable three-month table. Selected public passages were actually opened/read; table values agree with retained transformed packs. Read coverage and attempt/success distinctions: source-check.json.

Method revenue-yoy-v1: existing local v1 content/digest verified, unchanged. Its actual authorship is 2026-11-16T00:00:00+00:00. Generic package method/README read in this run; hashes in method-check.json. This is a reconstruction, not a contemporaneous or blind forecast. Q2 is comparison evidence, not a managed completed Q2 review. No eligible managed predecessor exists; retained Q2/Q3 drafts stay untouched.

Unread/excluded: full notes, risk factors, governance/proxy, full MD&A and cash-flow reconciliation; retained competition/forecast/price datasets not independently revalidated. Later economic observations are excluded; later-authored local methodology is labeled, not backdated. Retained notes use a different -04:00 cutoff; this run obeys SCOPE's exact UTC cutoff. No price target, rating, probability or return inferred. Investment-case remains pending.

# AAPL 2024Q3 bounded fiscal identity

Authored 2026-11-16T01:57:33.068714+00:00; assessment cutoff 2024-08-02T23:59:59+00:00.

Retained source declares fiscal year 2024, period Q3, endpoint 2024-06-29, original accession 0000320193-24-000081 and availability 2024-08-02. [Original 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000081/aapl-20240629.htm) cover identifies Apple/AAPL and June 29 endpoint; document footer labels Q3 2024, and extracted declaration text includes 2024/Q3/0000320193. This corroborates the supplied fiscal identity without inferring it from a filename, price date or calendar month. It is calendar Q2's endpoint, not Apple's fiscal Q2.

The three-month comparison ends July 1, 2023; cumulative nine-month columns are distinct. Retained Q2 accession 0000320193-24-000069 ends March 30, 2024, with a separate [original](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000069/aapl-20240330.htm) and six-month cumulative column. Neither accession is a revision of the other quarter. No managed predecessor is present; retained draft history is preserved.

Competing error tested: calendar-quarter labeling and cumulative-quarter confusion do not fit the original cover, Q3 footer and three-month headers. Bounded identity is corroborated. This does not claim full inline-XBRL context validation: raw tags/contextRef, filing-index date, amendments and fresh inventory were not checked. SEC helper not run because genuine SEC_USER_AGENT is absent; no identification invented. Retained JSON raw_ref/raw_digest bind transformed packs, not fetched HTML. Source-check.json records actual web success and exclusions. New authoritative contradictory declarations or accession/date evidence would invalidate this conclusion.
